item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.31)] Seattle Times, Newsday sue OpenAI, Microsoft, alleging copyright infringement
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.31)
The Seattle Times and Newsday have filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging copyright infringement. The newspapers claim the tech companies used their journalism without permission to train AI systems like ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot, leading to AI products that can reproduce or paraphrase their articles, reducing the need for users to visit their sites or subscribe. This lawsuit mirrors a similar case brought by The New York Times in 2023, adding to a growing number of legal challenges against AI companies for alleged misuse of copyrighted material.

item.description:

Through its new offerings, Equinix Fabric One and Equinix Inference Exchange, the company aims to simplify the deployment and management of distributed AI environments, particularly for inference workloads. These services address the growing need for low-latency, geographically optimized AI processing by bringing compute closer to data and users, leveraging partnerships with Nvidia and Together AI.
